screens.name: node-ts
setup: Action 'prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/11-modern-language-features' if C:\lab\pl11 is gone (npm install, dotnet build; it also creates the Python 3.13 venv the other screens need), then 'screen-prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/11-modern-language-features/node-ts': VS Code opens C:\lab\pl11 with src/ts/digest.ts at the Map.groupBy line (80)
If the Workspace Trust dialog appears: click 'Yes, I trust the authors'
Close the 'All installed extensions are temporarily disabled' notification with its X; if a terminal panel from an earlier run is open, click its bin icon (the panel closes)

Click the Explorer icon in the activity bar (the side bar hides), then the 'Split Editor Right' button at the top right of the editor: digest.ts shows twice, line 80 visible in both; task terminals open as a tab in the right-hand group (terminal.integrated.defaultLocation = editor), wide enough for the digest (64 columns) without wrapping
Record with 'screen-play: .../node-ts' just before window.go: the pointer script then performs the steps below by itself and ends the take
steps: Click Terminal > Run Task..., then 'node src/ts/main.ts samples/requests.json': a terminal tab opens in the right-hand editor group and prints the digest
Hold about 5 seconds, then click Terminal > Run Task..., then 'npx tsc -p tsconfig.json': nothing from the compiler, then 0 (its exit code), below the digest in the same terminal
Hold about 7 seconds with Map.groupBy (left) and the digest (right) both visible; park the pointer on the empty part of the activity bar; create recordings\stop
After the take: click the window's close button (X)
screens.expected: The digest as in expected/digest.txt: 'Contoso request digest', 'accepted 11, rejected 2, total 1,320,370.75 EUR, high priority 6', ... 'review batches of 4' with three batches. Then 'Executing task: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json; $LASTEXITCODE' followed only by 0. Node may print an ExperimentalWarning about type stripping (older Node 22/23): keep it if it shows, it is real.
mask: the round account picture at the bottom of the activity bar (about x 14-60, y 882-926 of the 1906x1025 take): the scene sets mask [[14, 882, 46, 44]] in script.yaml (the menu bar is used, so the title bar cannot be cropped away)
otherwise none expected: window title '... - pl11 - VS Code', folder under C:\lab, Accounts entry hidden
screens.note: Click-tier take: the two commands run as VS Code tasks (Terminal > Run Task..., left-clicks only); the task terminal echoes each command. The terminal sits in the editor area (second group) because a terminal panel on the right opens at a quarter of the window width (about 38 columns at this font) and wraps the digest mid-word; the panel cannot be widened with clicks. Editor font 16 so line 80 fits in half the window. No typescript.tsdk: TypeScript 7 (native) has no tsserver.js, VS Code uses its own TypeScript for the editor.
